audience: Danish bookkeepers and business owners who run their books in Talero

useCases.title: See which invoices are overdue
useCases.text: List the invoices with status overdue and open one to see its lines and totals. Then read the customer record for the payment terms.

useCases.title: Find a customer by CVR number, email or phone
useCases.text: Look up a customer by exact CVR number, email or phone. Read the full record with its contact and payment-terms fields.

useCases.title: Draft a sales invoice for a customer
useCases.text: Find the customer and the product, then create an invoice draft. The draft has no invoice number. Approve and send it in Talero.

useCases.title: Review profit, loss and the balance sheet
useCases.text: Read the profit and loss report and the balance sheet for a period. List the ledger transactions to check a figure.

useCases.title: Track purchase costs and their suppliers
useCases.text: List the expenses by status, such as pending, and open one to see its amount, VAT and date. Then read the supplier record.

useCases.title: Create or update a customer record
useCases.text: Create a customer with a name, or update one. Fields you leave out keep their current value.
